how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official website or notification PDF.
Fill in the application form (Annexure-I for Director/Secretary or Annexure-II for General Manager/Deputy General Manager) completely in block letters.
Attach photocopies of all relevant documents must be forwarded through proper channel.
Enclose photocopies of the ACRs/APARs for each page duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Assistant Director/Under Secretary for the last five years.
Enclose Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate.
Enclose Statement showing Major or Minor penalties, if any, imposed during the last ten years.
Forward the complete application through proper channel to Deputy General Manager (Personnel), APEDA, 3rd Floor, NCUI Building, 3 Institutional Area, August Kranti Marg, New Delhi-110016.

faq.question: Q1. What is APEDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: APEDA Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released to fill 7 vacancies for Director, Secretary, General Manager and Deputy General Manager posts on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in APEDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies notified for various posts under APEDA Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APEDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligible qualifications for APEDA posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Plantation, Agricultural Engineering, Veterinary Science, Food Processing, Dairy Technology, Foreign Trade, International Business, MBA (Finance) or Chartered Accountancy from ICAI along with 5 years experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APEDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for APEDA Recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for APEDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by filling out the prescribed application form and forwarding it through proper channel to Deputy General Manager (Personnel), APEDA, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for APEDA General Manager posts?
faq.answer: The General Manager post carries a pay scale of Pay Level 12 (Rs. 78,800 - 2,09,200).
